title: Making progress on my voxel god game inspired by the Black and White games
author: CapitanUncino19
selftext:
You can try the demo here: [https://capitanuncino.itch.io/handvoll](https://capitanuncino.itch.io/handvoll)

I posted here some time ago and got some really valuable feedback. Now many iterations later I am happy to share the progress I have made.

I rebuilt the entire game on finer voxels (or rather had fable rebuild it). Reworked the game mechanics and how you get spells etc. A lot of time was spent on the flicking mechanism, until it finally felt good. I wanted it to be hard but not to hard to throw stuff like trees and stuff at enemy ships outside of your zone of godly influence. I did it by having claude build a test world, designed only for throwing things at different targets, where I played around with all the settings and parameters a lot.

For the trailer I wrote a storyboard and had claude script the scenes in the game. The music is made with suno.
